відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The navy loafers give the dark grey trousers a quiet, polished finish, and the dark grey bag matches their depth, so the lower half of the outfit reads as one calm block. The graphite blazer sits over the lighter sweater as the outer layer. This is a restrained, classic office outfit built entirely on grey, and the light sweater under the darker blazer and trousers keeps the tones from going flat. The fitted blazer sets the eye on your shoulders and gives a clean, structured line, while the straight trousers carry it down your legs in one unbroken vertical, which adds length and keeps the silhouette tidy. Nothing here is loud or fussy, so it suits a full office day: the pieces stay neat through meetings and a desk, and the loafers are comfortable enough for hours on your feet.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the graphite blazer open over the grey sweater for a long, easy vertical line, and button it for meetings when you want a sharper look.\",\"Tuck the front of the grey sweater into the straight trousers to show where your waist sits under the open blazer.\",\"Keep the sweater smooth and unpushed at the sleeves under the fitted blazer so the shoulder line stays clean.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#78·18\",\"what\":\"grey sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#377·22\",\"what\":\"straight dark grey trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#135·12\",\"what\":\"graphite blazer\"},{\"n\":\"#474·03\",\"what\":\"navy loafers\"},{\"n\":\"#91·07\",\"what\":\"dark grey bag\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#78·18\",\"text\":\"A sweater in a soft, light grey with a faint cool tint. It is a smooth, simple knit top that brings a lighter tone up near your face.\"},{\"n\":\"#377·22\",\"text\":\"Straight-cut trousers in a deep charcoal grey. They fall in a clean line from hip to hem and give the outfit its quiet base.\"},{\"n\":\"#135·12\",\"text\":\"A fitted single-breasted blazer in graphite. It follows the body closely and gives the shoulders and the whole upper line a crisp structure.\"},{\"n\":\"#474·03\",\"text\":\"Classic loafers in deep navy. They are a smooth, low, polished shoe that finishes the outfit without drawing attention.\"},{\"n\":\"#91·07\",\"text\":\"A bag in a dark, muted grey with a simple, unfussy shape. Its understated colour sits close to the trousers and blazer.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":7211,"output_tokens":1526},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
